research_question: Does lagging the point-in-time monthly quarterly-signal panel by six calendar months reproduce the GKX quarterly block out of sample?
frozen_lineage_rule: First construct the point-in-time monthly signal using actual rdq with the existing fallback, then assign that monthly value to month t+6. This is a lag of the expanded monthly signal, not an offset applied directly to datadate.

frozen_formulas.cinvest: current investment rate minus mean of previous three rates
frozen_formulas.ms: low ROA volatility and low sales-growth volatility version retained only as a separately judged diagnostic

featurewise_decision_rule: Judge each feature separately. Passing features may enter the extension builder. A failing ms does not invalidate the six other quarterly features and must be excluded or separately resolved.
stopping_rule: No further lag or formula search after the 2010-2019 confirmation. Any failure requires a new source-backed version.
